Construct a DWD FST filename

dwd_fst_filename.Rd

Creates the filename used by both FST writers and readers. Historical filenames include the complete start date so datasets beginning on different dates cannot silently overwrite one another. Recent observations always use the stable filename recent_weather_dat.fst, because that file is refreshed in place.

Usage

dwd_fst_filename(
  dataperiod = c("historical", "recent"),
  startdate = "1990-01-01"
)

Arguments

dataperiod

Character scalar; either "historical" or "recent".

startdate

A single value coercible to Date giving the first date included in the dataset. It affects the historical filename; recent data use a stable filename without a date suffix.

Value

A character scalar containing a filename, without a directory.

Examples

dwd_fst_filename("historical", "1990-01-01")
#> [1] "weather_dat_1990-01-01.fst"
dwd_fst_filename("recent", as.Date("2025-07-01"))
#> [1] "recent_weather_dat.fst"
